# TradieInsurance.co.nz

> NZ's specialist tradie insurance comparison and referral service. We connect New Zealand tradies with licensed insurance brokers to find the best cover for their trade.

## About This Site

TradieInsurance.co.nz is an information and referral service for New Zealand tradies seeking insurance. We provide general information about tradie insurance options and connect users with licensed NZ insurance brokers regulated under the Financial Markets Conduct Act 2013.

**Important:** This website is NOT a licensed financial adviser. We do not provide financial advice. All insurance quotes and recommendations are provided by the licensed brokers we refer you to.

- Public Liability — from NZ$30/month
- Tools & Equipment — from NZ$25/month

- Contents & Property — from NZ$25/month

Builders, Plumbers, Painters, Carpenters & Woodworkers, Electricians, Bricklayers, Roofers, Concreters, Handymen

## Disclaimer

TradieInsurance.co.nz is a referral service only. We are not a registered financial adviser under the FMCA 2013. The brokers we refer you to ARE regulated under FMCA. All advice and quotes come from those licensed advisers, not from this website.
